atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Inserts Tailwind's base, components, utilities or variants styles.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tells Tailwind which bucket a set of custom styles belong to.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Specifies which config file Tailwind should use when compiling that CSS file.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Explicitly registers a source path for Tailwind v4 content scanning.
